notes: Paper 1 pre-registration v0.16.0 (23 Sep 2026); Deviation 56 (pre-registration v0.15.0, Section 3c, adopted 21 Sep 2026 on Owais's decision of 09:09-09:24 IST that the reserve conjecture test becomes Paper 1 Section 3c, no Paper 3): Block C on the n100 rung (10x10, actual n = 87, origin (2, 0), edge 75_85; the current placement under the Deviation 22 / 26 / 46 / 53 cuts, re-derived by the runner on the run day): k = 1 at L = 8 and L = 10, resilience 0, 65536 shots per shifted circuit (per-draw shot variance 1/(2N) = 7.63e-06, against 3.1e-5 at 16384 and 1.22e-4 at 4096), M = 200 draws per point in a new recorded seed block (seeds 25792001 at L = 8 and 25912001 at L = 10, draw d at seed + d; disjoint from every campaign, replication and reference block), plus the matched Deviation 43 L = 0 null control at 65536 shots (seed 25761001). L = 10 is outside the Section 2 ladder (1, 2, 4, 8, 12): it sits between the resolved L = 8 point and the shot-floor-limited L = 12 point of the same rung. What the block adds to Paper 1 (Section 3c): the L = 8 variance of the n100 rung resolved at a shot floor 16x below the 16384-shot headline point (draw sampling, not shots, then limits it), a third resolvable depth for H2 on the largest rung, and a per-draw record of 200 gradients at 65,536 shots (shot SE about 2.8e-3 per gradient) for the Section 3c per-draw comparison once a per-draw surrogate exists (Deviation 56: the transition map is conditional on a per-draw surrogate and the theorist's sign-off; without it the comparison is at the level of the variance and the distribution shape against the Pauli-propagation population moments). The Deviation 55 level-2 cap is recorded and does not bind (resilience 0 throughout). Order of runs (21 Sep 2026): day 3 (day3_dial_refs) first, then the Deviation 19 replication lists, then this list, each its own Batch, arming and ids file. Ledger: Section 6 main-grid line (190.5 min; the summary reports this block beside the main total). Pre-flight: docs/preflight/09_paper1_section3c_blockC_2026-09-21.md. Placement from snapshot 2026-09-23T163534Z (CSV plus raw properties; Deviations 22, 26 and 46 cuts plus the Deviation 53 coherence floor T1, T2 >= 25 us, on the newest committed calibration data): n100 = 10x10 n = 87 origin (2, 0) edge 75_85 broken [[86, 87], [100, 101], [31, 32], [95, 96], [87, 97], [100, 110]]. Deviation 46: the runner re-derives the placement and the observable edges from the run-day snapshot under the Deviation 22 / 26 cuts and the cone-graph edge rule (live re-check, layout_check enforce) and refuses a list whose n no longer matches; regenerate with scripts/make_paper1_joblists.py from the run-day snapshot and re-draw the Gate 1b reference predictions where the cone graph changed. Budget model v3 (Deviation 47: 3.0 s per job, +2.7 s at resilience >= 1, 5 us per execution, max(shots, 64) at resilience >= 1), jobs of at most 300 pubs (max_experiments; Deviation 48) and 12 MB of parameter values: 3 jobs, 600 pubs, 1200 parameter sets, 78643200 executions (+0 TREX), 16.141 min at the booked 1 us rep_delay (342.51 min at 250 us). Nothing is submitted while dry_run is true and the pre-flight review permalink is the placeholder.
